note: Messages a writer might type into NIE with the task each one asks for. Written by one set of independent writers and blind-labelled by two others who never saw the intended label; only items where both agreed are kept. Used to measure how well NIE understands what a writer asks (scripts/understanding-probe.mjs) and as a regression test for the rule-based fallback (tests/understand.test.js).
